# Security reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities or exposed sensitive data through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/cptntrps/Disneytime/security/advisories/new).
Reports go to the repository's maintainers.

Include the affected URL or file and enough redacted detail to locate the issue.
Do not include active credentials, private personal data, or other people's
confidential material. Do not post sensitive details in public issues or pull
requests.

For non-sensitive bugs and questions, see the [README](../README.md#questions-and-contributions).
